notes.title: 🚨 I’m Alive—and the Trailer Is Too 🚨
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45509261/cc4bf575b3736594504e1e5023a4623a60982be7.jpg"]👋 Hey everyone—Veluxa here.
Yes, I’ve emerged from the void of silence, and with good reason: the first official trailer is LIVE. If you haven’t seen it yet, go check it out now—it’ll give you a glimpse into the vibrant, twisted, and emotionally charged worlds I’ve been pouring my soul into. 

✨ Chapter 3 Is Done—and It’s a Beast
Here’s what we’ve accomplished together:

2,000+ stunning images

40,000+ words of branching dialogue

3 lengthy lewd scenes. They’re raw, unapologetically explicit BDSM sequences with dirty talk that pulls no punches. 

💋 Kinks explored so far:
MFF Threesomes

Virginity / First-time defloration

Anal, Deepthroat

Pregnancy, Lactation
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45509261/9a4e2b6256327bdf896d4f5e7f5880ca5d64214a.jpg"]
🔮 What’s Next?
Chapter 4 is underway and it’s shaping up beautifully

Early Access Release is planned for November 2025

Public demo (~500 images) is coming within a month 

Steam Next Fest (October): We’ll be part of the lineup

Starting now, I’ll be posting monthly progress reports right here on Steam. No more radio silence—you’ll be in the loop every step of the way.

🧡 Want to Help?
The best way to support the project right now? Wishlist it here on Steam. It boosts visibility in a huge way and tells the algorithm gods, “Hey, this is something special.”

Already done that? Even better—tell a friend. Word of mouth is everything, and I’m beyond grateful for every share, comment, and bit of hype you throw my way.  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318110/The_Last_Star_Walker_Book_One/"][/dynamiclink]More next month. Until then... stay curious and stay kinky. 🍑

– Veluxa 🔥
